'''Elicia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Secretary/Legends|secretary]] for [[Minister of Trade]] [[Fliry Vorru]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] during the [[Bacta War]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="bacta" />
